title: House of Flame and Shadow
author: Sarah J. Maas
summary: The third book in the Crescent City series. The heroine faces the aftermath of the previous books and a new, vast problem that stretches across worlds.
readIf: you want to see Crescent City continue and have finished the first two books.
skipIf: you want a standalone or have not read the earlier Crescent City novels.

pairings.reason: Another later series book that digs deeper into trauma and an unusual romance.
The author’s other grand finale, with a similarly huge scale and a lot of fighting.
A single-volume epic with queens and dragons for those who want a complete story.
